g.text: generic-inject-example
Injects CPython into a live Soldier of Fortune process, runs a Python payload inside it, and streams that payload's output back to the terminal.
Entry points
Core
State
External
`test.py` · driver: process name in, Python injected, payload output streamed back
`launch.sh` · git-bash wrapper that calls `cmd.exe /C python.exe test.py NAME PATH`
the stub template · Python source, kept as a string in `test.py`: open the pipe, redirect stdout and stderr, run the payload as `__mayhem__`
`script.py` · the example payload: call engine `COM_Printf` at 0x2001C6E0, then print
`orig.py` · upstream `python_injector.py` untouched, kept as the diff baseline
`Pipfile` · python 3.8 plus boltons, the one third-party package
`getpid.py` · `EnumProcesses` then `GetProcessImageFileNameA`, first basename match wins
`WindowsProcess(pid=...)` · mayhem handle: read and write memory, allocate, remote threads
locate `pythonXY.dll` · scanned out of `sys.path` by filename, not `find_library`
`LoadLibrary` in the target · by absolute path, so the target must read it and match bitness
resolve two exports · `Py_InitializeEx` and `PyRun_SimpleString` as remote base plus local delta
start the interpreter · `Py_InitializeEx(0)` in a remote thread, then join
run the stub · `PyRun_SimpleString` on the stub string copied into the target
named pipe server · duplex, message mode, 255 instances, blocking connect
stream and tear down · echo until the pipe breaks, join, re-init, free the dll
nothing is written · no config, no log, no cache · the payload path comes from argv
`script.py` on disk · the target opens it by absolute path, so the game must be able to read it
the named pipe · the only channel out, anything not written to it is lost
the target process · SoF 1.06 in practice, it owns 0x2001C6E0 and executes the injected code
`pythonXY.dll` · must match the driver's major.minor and the game's bitness
vendored `mayhem` 0.5.0 · win32 ctypes bindings, BSD-3, untouched subtree
`windows_syscalls.db` · 39,761 syscall numbers shipped with mayhem, unused here
one path, one bitness
the stub connects back
output until EOF
the driver wires the three pieces together
nothing persisted, one pipe carries the output
loads a dll into another process and calls its exports
